title: 2 soldiers wounded in Maguindanao del Norte ambush

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Two soldiers were seriously wounded after gunment opened fire on their motorcyle along a national highway in Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Tuesday afternoon, police said. Police arrested two suspects in a hot pursuit operation shortly after the attack, according to the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR). Capt. Steffi Salanguit,
